reasoning: The failures are not caused by the test code or an application bug, but by a timing race between the sandbox's asynchronous seed-indexing pipeline and the start of the ordered suite. Evidence: (1) the same app + spec passed 11/12 in the two 08-01 runs (only the already-fixed sharing_revoke_a_device redirect race failed then), proving the sharing feature and its selectors work against a properly seeded sandbox; (2) the 08-23 sandbox data dir contains the seeded 'Family Photos' files and the media directory is configured — pairing, list_shared, grant creation, and sidebar rows all worked; (3) the DB WAL (yaffo.db-wal) shows the seed enqueued an asynchronous pipeline import_photos -> index_photos -> classify_labels -> auto_assign_faces, with classify_labels/auto_assign_faces still RUNNING at 23:00:04 (~4 minutes after the test run ended at ~22:56) and the taskq worker only starting when the web app booted at 22:49:10. The tests began browsing A's shared gallery at ~22:50, before photos were indexed, so the gallery rendered 'No shared files found' (no .remote-photo-grid / no .remote-photo-card), and /albums had no 'Seeded Album' (the album is built from indexed photos). This is a readiness/timing problem in the isolated environment, not a defect in the generated test.
affectedTests: Sharing Feature › sharing_grant_a_media_directory_and_browse_it - A shares a media directory and B browses it with filters
Sharing Feature › sharing_gallery_without_a_download_directory - Without a download directory nothing is selectable, then set one
Sharing Feature › sharing_pull_selected_photos - B selects two photos and pulls them as a background batch
Sharing Feature › sharing_pull_everything_matching - B pulls every photo matching a filter minus one unticked
Sharing Feature › sharing_grant_a_folder - A shares one subfolder and B sees only its photos
Sharing Feature › sharing_grant_an_album - A shares an album and its membership is resolved per request
Sharing Feature › sharing_album_share_modal_toggle - The album Share modal shares with a device and un-shares it again
Sharing Feature › sharing_revoke_a_grant - Revoking a share stops the peer next request but keeps pulled files
suggestedAction: Add a readiness gate so `npm run isolatedEnvironment:start:sharing` does not report ready until the seeded library's background pipeline (import_photos -> index_photos -> classify_labels -> auto_assign_faces) has completed and the seeded album is visible on instance A (e.g. wait for A's /albums to list 'Seeded Album' and the home gallery to return photos). Then re-run the ordered suite against a fresh sandbox. Optionally, harden the first browsing test to poll for A's populated library before asserting on the remote gallery.
